name: jdwp-debugging
description: Java JDWP debugger via MCP — set breakpoints, inspect runtime state, evaluate expressions, mutate variables, catch exceptions at throw site, trace execution with logpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Debug running Java applications over JDWP
interface.longDescription: Attach to a JVM over JDWP and debug it from the agent: breakpoints, conditional and exception breakpoints, logpoints, field watchpoints, stepping, locals, fields and object graphs, Java expression evaluation in the suspended frame, and changing values at runtime. Needs a JDK 17+ on PATH.
defaultPrompt: This test fails — attach the debugger and find out why
Find which code writes this field
Catch this exception where it is thrown
